explain: Vehicles are legally mandated to stop for pedestrians on zebra crossings.

q: Playing with matches, candle flames, or lighters in the house can cause dangerous ____. (P2)
explain: Matches and open flames are fire hazards that children must never touch.

q: When electric wires are naked or damaged, touching them can cause severe ____. (P2)
explain: Never touch exposed wires or wet electrical switches.
